components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default committed action; use for the most important available operation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-active-500); color: var(--color-on-accent); font: 600 14px/1.5 var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-active-600); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-active-500); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-active-600); }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Stable form input with inset state rings instead of shifting borders.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-canvas); color: var(--color-fg); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-border); outline: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-field input:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--color-accent-subtle); } .ds-field input:focus { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-active-500); }

components.name: Outlined Card
components.description: Default container for summaries, tables, and operational panel groups.
components.html:
Release status

Review the current lifecycle and supporting evidence.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-canvas); color: var(--color-fg); font-family: var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Permission-aware dashboard navigation with quiet active and hover states.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--color-fg-muted); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-fg); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-fg); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-active-500); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Semantic status marker that pairs a tinted surface with readable text and a matching border.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-success-border); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-success-surface); color: var(--color-success-fg); font: 600 12px/1.5 var(--font-poppins), Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: CRA Sentinel is a sober, high-trust operating environment for regulatory work that may be reviewed years later. The interface uses neutral surfaces, precise borders, and a single verification-blue action language to keep sensitive tasks calm and legible. It supports light, dark, and organization-branded dashboard contexts without altering the structural or status vocabulary. The system is deliberately restrained rather than austere. Dense tools such as registries, tables, form workflows, and evidence views rely on a compact component scale; new surfaces should nevertheless create generous page-level breathing room and clear visual chapters for scanability.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite and white surfaces establish concentration before color is introduced.
Verification Indigo marks the primary path, selected state, focus treatment, and organization accent scope.
Rounded 12px controls soften a rigorous operational interface without becoming playful.
Tonal layers and precise borders create hierarchy; conspicuous shadow is reserved for interactive elevation.
Motion is short, state-led, and disabled for reduced-motion users.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Color Rule
rules.body: Use color to locate action, state, and risk. Never use it as ornamental fill, and do not use status colors as a substitute for labels or text.

rules.name: The Muted-Text Safety Rule
rules.body: fg-muted is for text at least 18.66px or bold text at least 14px; fg-subtle is reserved for disabled and placeholder content. Ordinary body copy uses fg.

rules.name: The Spacious-Frame Rule
rules.body: Preserve the compact type scale inside operational widgets, but use clear page-title separation, 24–30px desktop gutters, and generous section breaks whenever the workflow does not require constant comparison.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Actionable Rule
rules.body: Static information stays flat or border-defined. Elevation appears only to clarify an overlay, focus, or a genuinely interactive container.

dos: Do use semantic surface, foreground, border, and status tokens instead of raw utility colors.
Do keep primary actions in Verification Indigo and reserve status ramps for their actual meaning.
Do preserve 12px rounding and compact 32–56px control heights across shared patterns.
Do provide focus-visible states and retain motion-reduce behavior for every introduced interaction.
Do make new pages spacious at the composition level while preserving dense, scannable operational widgets.
donts: Don't use fg-muted for regular-size body copy or fg-subtle for active copy.
Don't use large resting shadows or decorative gradients to manufacture hierarchy.
Don't widen organization branding beyond the dashboard accent scope or replace structural/status tokens with tenant colors.
Don't hide layout overflow on html or size primary layouts with 100vw; overlay scroll locking depends on the current document behavior.
